cohort: 159 women between 20-40 years of age, free of chronic and infectious diseases and presenting with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Cesarean section was associated with lower maternal circulating concentrations of adiponectin at 30-45 days postpartum, compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with lower maternal circulating concentrations of adiponectin at 30-45 days postpartum, compared to vaginal delivery.
